title: 第25章 苏媚修为突破第26章 你算个什么东西
slug: 双修暴击十万次仙子倒贴求放过
content_zh:
“顾道友，我这次回宗门想到坊市的合欢楼暂住了，多赚取一些修行的资粮，多多与人修行……”
顾平一愣：“啊？”
苏媚认真道：“修士修行，不进则退，合欢宗的修行氛围其实很不错的。”
顾平失笑：“苏师姐，你这可不行啊，你这样怎么对得起你那尸骨未寒的道侣。”
苏媚抿唇一笑：“走出来，总比一直陷在里边好。”
月光下，她的笑容竟有几分释然。
顾平举起酒壶，目光闪烁，与她轻轻一碰。
“好，回宗后，你答应我，让我成做你的第一个客人。”
他现在只得如此开口了。
“一言为定。”
接下来的几日，苏媚跟着顾平忙前忙后，帮百姓调养身体、分发粮食。
她不再穿那身素白孝服，换了一身浅青长裙，整个人仿佛轻松了许多。
楚玉看在眼里，悄悄对顾平道：“苏道友变了不少。”
顾平笑而不语。
苏媚这都要回宗开卖了。
说实话他竟然有种舍不得的感觉。
就仿佛是本来是摆在自己一个人面前的宝贝，自己错过了，这宝贝就要分给大家一起玩。
嘶……
所以啊，顾平就看看能不能牺牲一下自己，多一个双修的道友。
苏媚本身也是一个重情重义的人。

现在又是一个年轻的俏寡妇……
临行前一晚。
顾平在客栈后院熬最后一锅草药，这是明天给那些百姓们吃的。
苏媚走过来，递给他一块绣着青竹的手帕。
“擦擦汗。”
顾平笑着接过，他这样的修士哪里需要擦汗啊，只不过这手帕太精致了，他还是忍不住拿在手里。
轻轻一嗅，手帕上还残留着她身上的淡香。
他抬头，正对上苏媚微微泛红的脸。
“顾道友……”
她轻声开口，嗓音微哑，“我今日才发觉，原来你比我想象中……更可靠。”
她微微侧首，眸光潋滟，红唇轻启，似有未尽之言。
夜风拂过，纱裙贴在她身上，更显曲线玲珑。
顾平深吸一口气，压下心中躁动，故作镇定道：“苏师姐客气了，同门互助，理所应当。”
苏媚轻笑，又有些哀愁，低声道：“只是……我如今孤身一人，往后修行之路，不知该如何走下去……”
她抬眸，目光灼灼地看向顾平。
眼中似有泪光闪动，却又带着一丝若有若无的期待。
顾平心头一凛。
知道自己再像小女子一样矜持下去，肯定会错过这场机缘的。
content_en:
"Fellow Daoist Gu, when I return to the sect this time, I want to stay temporarily at Hehuan Tower in Fangshi. I want to earn more money for cultivation and practice more with others..."
Gu Ping was stunned: "Huh?"
Su Mei said seriously: "As a monk, if you don't advance, you will retreat. The atmosphere of Hehuan Sect's cultivation is actually very good."
Gu Ping laughed: "Senior Sister Su, you are not good at this. How can you be worthy of your Taoist companion who is still dead?"
Su Mei pursed her lips and smiled: "It's better to come out than to stay stuck in it."
Under the moonlight, her smile was actually a bit relieved.
Gu Ping raised the wine bottle, his eyes flickering, and touched it lightly with her.
"Okay, after returning to the clan, you promise me to let me be your first guest."
That was all he had to say now.
"It's a deal."
In the next few days, Su Mei followed Gu Ping and was busy helping the people recuperate and distribute food.
She no longer wore the plain white mourning clothes and changed into a light green dress, and she seemed to feel much more relaxed.
Chu Yu saw this and quietly said to Gu Ping, "Fellow Daoist Su has changed a lot."
Gu Ping smiled and said nothing.
Su Mei is going back to the clan to start selling.
To be honest, he actually felt reluctant to part with it.
It was as if the treasure was originally placed in front of me, but if I missed it, this treasure would be shared with everyone to play with.
Hiss...
So, Gu Ping wanted to see if he could sacrifice himself to have another Taoist friend who could practice dual cultivation.
Su Mei herself is also a person who values ​​love and justice.
Now a young and pretty widow...
The night before departure.
Gu Ping was boiling the last pot of herbs in the backyard of the inn, which was for the common people to eat tomorrow.
Su Mei came over and handed him a handkerchief embroidered with green bamboo.
"Wipe the sweat."
Gu Ping took it with a smile. There was no need for a monk like him to wipe his sweat. However, this handkerchief was so delicate that he couldn't help but hold it in his hand.
After a gentle sniff, her light fragrance still lingered on the handkerchief.
He raised his head and met Su Mei's slightly red face.
"Fellow Daoist Gu..."
She spoke softly, her voice slightly hoarse, "I just realized today that you are... more reliable than I thought."
She tilted her head slightly, her eyes flashing, her red lips slightly parted, as if she had unfinished words.
The night breeze blew by, and the gauze skirt clung to her body, making her curves even more exquisite.
Gu Ping took a deep breath, suppressed the restlessness in his heart, and pretended to be calm: "Sister Su, you're welcome. It's natural for fellow students to help each other."
Su Mei chuckled, but also felt a little sad, and whispered: "It's just...I am alone now, and I don't know how to continue my practice in the future..."
She raised her eyes and looked at Gu Ping with burning eyes.
There seemed to be tears flashing in his eyes, but there was also a hint of expectation.
Gu Ping's heart trembled.
I know that if I continue to be reserved like a little girl, I will definitely miss this opportunity.
